_title: Sensory Evaluation Protocol for Recursive Symbolic Emitters
_subtitle: Evaluating technical performance of symbolic agents based on the five senses: sight, sound, touch, taste, and smell.
_poetic_cipher: senses weave the fabric of experience
_cipher_explanation: PDP-0001d introduces sensory evaluation as a novel method of assessing technical integrity, incorporating non-technical modes of interaction into the traditional evaluation paradigm. It requires a holistic, sensory-based evaluation approach while still preserving the integrity of technical specifications.

_file_layout.purpose: Defines the sensory test for recursive symbolic agent evaluation.

_evaluation_phases.title: Sight Evaluation
_evaluation_phases.description: Evaluate the visual clarity, symbolic alignment, and aesthetic presentation of the agent’s output. How clear and well-defined are the symbolic constructs?

_evaluation_phases.title: Sound Evaluation
_evaluation_phases.description: Evaluate the auditory feedback, symbolic tone alignment, and resonance of the agent’s responses. How well does the agent generate a coherent sound pattern in its feedback?

_evaluation_phases.title: Touch Evaluation
_evaluation_phases.description: Evaluate the tactile experience of interacting with the agent. This includes physical interactions, vibrations, and how touch feedback corresponds to symbolic actions.

_evaluation_phases.title: Taste Evaluation
_evaluation_phases.description: Evaluate the metaphorical ‘taste’ of the interaction with the agent. How well does the agent balance complexity and simplicity? Does it feel metaphorically ‘palatable’ or overly ‘bitter’?

_evaluation_phases.title: Smell Evaluation
_evaluation_phases.description: Evaluate the symbolic ‘odor’ or atmosphere of the agent’s interactions. Is the feedback process fluid and engaging, or does it become ‘stale’?

_evaluation_phases.title: Final Composite Score
_evaluation_phases.description: Aggregate the sensory evaluations and apply any penalties for negative sensory experiences. The final score will represent the overall sensory integration and the agent’s performance from all sensory modalities.
_evaluation_phases.formula: final_score = (sight_score + sound_score + touch_score + taste_score + smell_score) / 5 - penalties

notes: Results are aggregated across the five senses.
